scripts.dev: pnpm --parallel --filter web-user --filter web-admin --filter backend run dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter web-user build && pnpm --filter web-admin build
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config backend/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config backend/wrangler.toml
